method: Nonblank physical lines. Specs include predicates, contracts and external loop assertions; annotations are in-C attributes/comments. Proof lines include separate scaffolding and helper lemmas. See line_audit for every counted line. Manual steps are syntactic tactic occurrences (Rocq) or apply/by/proof(method) invocations (Isabelle); control combinators are not expanded. Embedded RefinedC tactics count as manual. Generated proofs are separately reported. Timing includes front-end and checking, excludes installation and cache cleanup; libraries/AFP parent heaps stay built. Three runs, tools run sequentially. Peak RSS is max child-process RSS reported by GNU time, not sum of concurrent processes.
